name: Generative Agents
titleZh: 生成式智能体：人类行为的交互式模拟
summary: An architecture of observation, planning and reflection that lets twenty-five agents in a Sims-like sandbox produce believable individual and emergent social behaviour.
summaryZh: 用「观察—规划—反思」三层架构，让 25 个智能体在类《模拟人生》沙盒里涌现出可信的个体行为与社会行为。
keyFact: Generative Agents (Park et al., arXiv:2304.03442, 2023-04-07) populated a sandbox town with twenty-five agents whose behaviour came from memory, reflection and planning, and its ablations showed all three components are needed for believable behaviour.
keyFactZh: Generative Agents（Park 等，arXiv:2304.03442，2023-04-07）在沙盒小镇里放了 25 个智能体，行为由记忆、反思与规划驱动；消融实验显示这三个组件缺一不可。
whyItMatters: It is the reference architecture for memory in agents — the design later memory layers either adopt or argue against.
whyItMattersZh: 它是智能体记忆的参考架构——后来的记忆层要么沿用这套设计，要么明确反对它。
title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
